Public Finance Committee
Agenda

Meeting: 25th meeting
Venue: Committee Room 11
Date: 26 October 2026 (Monday)
Time: 11:30 am

1. Reviewing the matter sent by the Petitions Committee requesting the Public Finance Committee's views regarding the "Petition calling to cancel the expensive health insurance provided to Members of Parliament but not available to the general public".

2. Sharing with the committee the following reports submitted to the committee;
➢ Report of the Auditor General's Office on the work carried out in the first quarter of 2026 and the functioning of the office.
➢ Study report prepared by the Anti-Corruption Commission identifying corruption risks in the system of organising and managing sports.
➢ Annual Report 2025 of the Maldives Monetary Authority.

3. Reviewing the following reports submitted to the committee;
➢ Budget outcome statement for 2025, as stated in Article 25 of Law No. 30/2024 (Fiscal Responsibility Act).

➢ Annual Debt Report 2025.

➢ Details of loans taken by the State, loans for which the State has issued sovereign guarantees, and loans issued by the State as at the end of the second quarter of 2026, as stated in Article 32 of Law No. 29/2024 (Public Debt Act).
